architecture.candidate_selection: within each frozen lambda, exact decoded relative_MSE+lambda*literal_bpw is reported; the transmitted winner across lambdas minimizes literal F, then bytes, candidate order and lambda order
architecture.name: PAIRPATH-P2-r2
architecture.scope: bounded adjacent pair of experts from one homogeneous SwiGLU-MoE layer

binding.rule: hash canonical little-endian FP64 source bytes, literal packet bytes, independently decoded labels and scales; recompute all four hashes from supplied bytes

controls.affine_operation: permute FP64 values independently within each expert/role/2048 block, then rerun scale estimation, quantization, model fitting, selection, packet encode/decode and score
controls.bootstrap: joint whole-block resampling with full pipeline refit; nearest-rank upper 95th percentile
controls.gaussian: moment match FP64 source independently per expert/role/2048 block, then rerun complete pipeline
jackknife: whole expert with singleton independent refit diagnostic

known_evidence.cbib_fixed_label_verdict: fixed-label same-layer conditional entropy is dead under CBIB-1

oracle.claim: kill-only; source-derived single-letter probabilities and convexified time sharing are free

packet.layout: [page-rounded common canonical header+state streams][page-rounded private expert 0 scales+labels][page-rounded private expert 1 scales+labels]
packet.read_rule: for every expert, both padded ownership and conservative raw-ownership cold-read amplification must be strictly below 2
packet.streams: canonical Huffman over KT 2*n+1 weights; exact valid-bit lengths; every fitted count and selector serialized

stopping.finite: one independently decoded packet must have F<=0.8, literal R in [2.15,2.5], and maximum conservative cold read <2
stopping.promotion: requires controls and at least two whole held-out layers
stopping.stage0: run fixed-assignment MI and optimistic equal-flexibility joint gate first; hard-kill below 0.045 bpw

universality: decoder may use only packet bytes, expert-pair membership, tensor shape, role and public coordinates; model identity, provenance, external checkpoints and untransmitted source state are forbidden
